rationale: Jamie is building Twigg AI, a context management tool for LLM workflows that applies Git-style version control to conversations—directly addressing the developer experience problem in LLM tooling. Saurabh is an AI Engineer at HiJenny AI with hands-on experience building AI-adjacent developer tools across Python and JavaScript, making him a natural technical collaborator who understands both the backend infrastructure and builder mindset needed to evaluate or extend Twigg's approach.
intro_message: Jamie Borland, meet Saurabh Khire — you're both deep in the LLM developer tools space and Saurabh's experience building AI tooling could be valuable input on Twigg's context management approach.
